---
title: "Labs"
---

The primary hands-on artifact of this course is the **Open Engineering Mini Kernel** living in `kernel/`.

## Suggested lab sequence

1. **Rust-only tests** — `cargo test` inside `kernel/`
2. **First binding** — expose and call `normalize_identifier`
3. **Identifier class** — construct and reject invalid identifiers from Python
4. **Manifest validation** — feed valid and invalid dicts
5. **Rule evaluation** — write a small rule and observe match / no-match
6. **Python contract tests** — `pytest tests/python`
7. **Wheel packaging** — `maturin build --release` and install into a clean environment

## Running the automated suites

```bash
cd kernel

# Domain logic (no Python required)
cargo test

# Public Python contract (requires maturin develop first)
maturin develop
pytest tests/python -q
```

See the [Capstone](../modules/15-capstone.qmd) for the complete acceptance criteria.
